issue.title: Status of testing of Apache Airflow 3.2.1rc3
issue.body:
### Body

We are kindly requesting that contributors to [Apache Airflow RC 3.2.1rc1](https://pypi.org/project/apache-airflow/3.2.1rc1/) help test the RC.

Please let us know by commenting if the issue is addressed in the latest RC.

- [ ] [[v3-2-test] connections import now returns non-zero exit code on failure (#64416) (#64449)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64449): @henry3260
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix TypeError in GET /dags/{dag_id}/tasks when order_by field has None values (#64384) (#64587)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64587): @antonio-mello-ai @amordoch
     Linked issues:
     - [/dags/{dag_id}/tasks improper null handling for order_by (#63927)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/63927)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix #62414: Remove spurious blank lines in filtered task log download (#64235) (#64640)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64640): @kacpermuda @bennyc0de
     Linked issues:
     - [Logs downloaded as empty file when filtering by log level (#62414)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/62414)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Return 410 Gone for heartbeat when cleared TI exists in TIH (#61631) (#64693)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64693): @amoghrajesh @andreahlert
     Linked issues:
     - [Better error handling for running ti heartbeats after task is cleared (#53140)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/53140)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix N+1 query pattern in task instance states and count endpoints (#60352) (#64695)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64695): @steveahnahn
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix OTel metrics lost in forked task processes (#64703) (#64720)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64720): @MichaelRBlack
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(scheduler): skip asset-triggered dags without SerializedDagModel (#64322) (#64738)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64738): @leossantos
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix start_date in example DAGs to avoid TZ conversion overflow (#63882) (#64758)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64758): @vagetablechicken
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] UI: Filter DagVersionSelect options based on selected DagRun (#64736) (#64771)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64771): @dandanseo123
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(ui): correct external link target and add rel attributes (#64542) (#64772)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64772): @Mayankaggarwal8055
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Backport #62849: Fix structlog positional formatting for single-dict arguments (#64773)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64773): @YoannAbriel
     Linked issues:
     - [Fix structlog positional formatting for single-dict arguments (#62849)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/62849)
- [x] [[v3-2-test] Fix group/extra bug in initialize_virtualenv (#62230) (#64808)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64808): @potiuk @tuzonghua
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Allow UI theme config without tokens (CSS-only or empty fallback) (#64552) (#64852)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64852): @cmarteepants
     Linked issues:
     - [Allow UI theme config without tokens (CSS-only or empty fallback) (#64552)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64552)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix Gantt view "Error invalid date" on running DagRun (#64752) (#64853)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64853): @alamashir
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(ui): prevent duplicate nav sidebar when iframe navigates away from auth pages (#63873) (#64854)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64854): @nagasrisai @Petrinax

     - [Duplicate Left Navigation Menu on "Airflow" Icon click. (#63805)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/63805)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(ui): cancel debounce on clear to prevent stale search value (#64893) (#64907)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64907): @Mayankaggarwal8055
- [x] [[v3-2-test] Fix CARGO_HOME location for airflow user builds (#64899) (#64914)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64914): @potiuk

- [ ] [[v3-2-test] UI: Implement automatic link target detection for extra_links (#64404) (#64967)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64967): @Subham-KRLX

- [ ] [[v3-2-test] feat: restore os provider on core library (#64764) (#65003)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65003): @Owen-CH-Leung

- [x] [[v3-2-test] Prevent path traversal via AIRFLOW_CLI_ENVIRONMENT in airflowctl (#64618) (#65096)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65096): @rjgoyln
- [x] [[v3-2-test] Fix CLI error handling and exit codes for failed commands(#65052) (#65097)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65097): @bugraoz93 @rjgoyln
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Add fast-path heartbeat UPDATE to avoid row lock in the common case (#65029) (#65137)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65137): @ephraimbuddy @vatsrahul1001
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(ui): use fixed menu positioning for dropdowns in connection forms (#65007) (#65085) (#65138)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65138): @tysoncung @darkag
     Linked issues:
     - [Dropdown list is not fully visible in connection form (#65007)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/65007)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix(ui): sync SearchBar value with defaultValue changes (#65054) (#65140)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65140): @Mayankaggarwal8055
- [x] [[v3-2-test] Re export AirflowPlugin to fix mypy errors in plugins (#65132) (#65163)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65163): @jscheffl @amoghrajesh
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix redirect loop when stale root-path `_token` cookie exists from older Airflow instance (#64955) (#65177)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65177): @wolfdn
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Prevent Session leak from StreamingResponse API endpoints (#65193)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65193): @ashb @vatsrahul1001
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Prevent Session from staying opened between yields (#65179) (#65195)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65195): @pierrejeambrun
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix sdk configuration to use $AIRFLOW_CONFIG env (#64936) (#65200)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65200): @wjddn279
- [x] [[v3-2-test] feat: add `write_to_os` writing task logs to opensearch (#64364) (#65201)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65201): @Owen-CH-Leung @potiuk @github-actions[bot]
     Linked issues:
     - [[v3-2-test] feat: restore os provider on core library (#64764) (#65003)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65003)
     - [feat: restore opensearch provider & add write_to_os feature (#64364)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64364)
     - [feat: restore os provider on core library (#64764)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/64764)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Reduce per-DAG queries during DAG serialization with bulk prefetch (#64929) (#65208)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65208): @ephraimbuddy
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix serializer for empty string extra connection (#65014) (#65215)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65215): @pierrejeambrun
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] UI: Show deactivated state for stale DAGs (#65214) (#65218)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65218): @pierrejeambrun @yavin87
     Linked issues:
     - [Deactivating an active DAG has no deactivation indicator in UI (#63800)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/63800)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix: add RUN, HITL_DETAIL, TASK_INSTANCE entities to /dags endpoint as it returns nested entities in response (#64822) (#65225)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65225): @sjyangkevin
- [x] [[v3-2-test] Fix asset graph view leaking DAGs outside the user's permissions (#65273) (#65280)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65280): @potiuk
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix get_team_name_dep creating wasted async sessions when multi_team=False (#65275) (#65282)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65282): @kaxil
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Fix dispose_orm() not disposing async engine on shutdown (#65274) (#65284)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65284): @vatsrahul1001 @kaxil @uranusjr
     Linked issues:
     - [Add endpoint to watch dag run until finish (#51920)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/51920)
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] Lock TriggerCommsDecoder sync req-res cycle (#64882) (#65285)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65285): @uranusjr
- [x] [[v3-2-test] fix(migration): add missing disable_sqlite_fkeys to 0108 migraiton (#65288) (#65290)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65290): @vatsrahul1001 @ephraimbuddy @YoannAbriel @github-actions[bot] @dandanseo123 @jscheffl @Lee-W @potiuk @dependabot[bot] @bugraoz93 @pierrejeambrun
- [ ] [Add overridable metadata engine creation hooks in `settings.py` (#62184) (#65293)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65293): @avolant @vatsrahul1001
- [ ] [Remove outdated TODO comment about permissions (#64169) (#65295)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65295): @pierrejeambrun @vatsrahul1001
- [ ] [Fix zip DAG import errors being cleared during bundle refresh (#63617) (#65296)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65296): @vatsrahul1001 @gopidesupavan
- [ ] [Change default sort to 'id' for list task instances (#64168) (#65297)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65297): @pierrejeambrun @vatsrahul1001
- [ ] [[v3-2-test] fix: use Dag form when materializing asset (#64211) (#65303)](https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/65303): @vatsrahul1001 @Lee-W


Thanks to all who contributed to the release (probably not a complete list!):
@andreahlert @YoannAbriel @dandanseo123 @dabla @jscheffl @tysoncung @MichaelRBlack @amordoch @sjyangkevin @henry3260 @nagasrisai @bennyc0de @Petrinax @justinpakzad @Subham-KRLX @Lee-W @kaxil @bugraoz93 @holmuk @uranusjr @pierrejeambrun @Mayankaggarwal8055 @tuzonghua @shubhamraj-git @amoghrajesh @leossantos @ephraimbuddy @avolant @potiuk @antonio-mello-ai @gopidesupavan @darkag @fat-catTW @ashb @vatsrahul1001 @wolfdn @rjgoyln @alamashir @cmarteepants @steveahnahn @kacpermuda @wjddn279 @yavin87 @Owen-CH-Leung @vagetablechicken
